title: Pool protocol v1 message: eviction_notice (router -> coordinator)
description: A local model was unloaded by its owner. Queued/offered jobs that named this model are gone: the coordinator drops them from candidacy and (for pre-token stages) may re-dispatch within the class (D-G1). Also invalidates skip/pin for this model (D-E4).

router_id.description: Router_id of the sending router (as in handshake).

model_id.description: Local model id that was unloaded.

evicted_jobs.description: Job ids that were queued or offered on this model and are now gone. May be empty if the router does not track them.

reason.description: owner_unload: the owner unloaded the model (normal); other: anything else.
